Borin's Lifts

Commissioned in ages past by the Council of Guilds, these twin lifts are the masterwork of the engineer Borin, whose name is still invoked in murmured awe. Their counterbalanced dance is so precise, so unerring, that some whisper it bears the touch of the Divine Arbiter's hand. Forged with chains born of metallurgic perfection, each link echoes generations of dwarvish craft. Borin left no margin for flaw--every stone placed, every cog aligned, every groove etched to match his singular vision. The result is not merely functional, but eternal, a monument to a mind that forged its will in steel.
